products.name: 2026 Advent Calendar
products.details: Dr. Ceuracle Kombucha Essence (150ml), ROUND LAB Birch Juice Cream (80ml) and AROMATICA Rosemary Scalp Scrub (165g) are substantial routine staples.
products.take: Buy for skincare restocking. Pass for a makeup-first countdown: several cleansers and lip products make the assortment less varied than the 30+ headline suggests.

products.name: Advent Calendar
products.hook: A fragrance-led countdown, with a hamper worth keeping.
products.details: 25 gifts, including 10 gift exclusives. Perfume, body spray and a candle sit alongside bath and body products in a reusable green wicker hamper. North American contents.
products.take: Buy for the bath-and-fragrance fan. Ten gifts are bath bombs or bubble bars, so this is a poor fit for a shower-only routine.

products.name: 24 Days of Tea
products.hook: A different little tea ritual behind every door.
products.details: 24 loose-leaf blends, with two 250ml servings per day. The gingerbread-house calendar mixes caffeinated and caffeine-free options. An infuser is needed.
products.take: Buy for someone who enjoys playful, dessert-inspired blends. Pass for a purist wanting only unflavoured tea, or an entirely caffeine-free countdown.

products.name: Popcorn Advent Calendar
products.hook: The countdown that turns into movie night.
products.details: 24 doors of non-GMO popping corn, sweet-and-savoury seasonings and recipes, made by Indiana’s family-owned Wabash Valley Farms.
products.take: Buy for the make-it-together household. The fun is popping and tasting; pass if you want an instant snack. These are raw kernels, and some doors hold seasoning. A popper is not included.

products.name: Disney Princess Advent Calendar 2026
products.hook: Little builds, then a whole new way to play.
products.details: 24 doors, 290 pieces and four microdolls: Ariel, Cinderella, Moana and Mulan. Four animal friends join them, and the box folds into a board game for up to eight players. Ages 5+. Set 43298.
products.take: Buy for younger Disney fans and daily play. Pass if you want full-size character figures or a substantial display build: these are microdolls and miniature models.
